welcome.title: Welcome to Rigorium
welcome.body: This short tour walks you through every major surface — chat, research, settings, routing, vision, and the self-bootstrapping paper workflow. You can skip it anytime.

chat.title: Chat is the entry point
chat.body: Ask anything here. The agent routes each request to the best model tier, compacts context automatically, and recovers from failures. Research-language queries (literature, experiment, manuscript…) automatically activate the research panel on the right.

sidebar.title: Sidebar: sessions and global tools
sidebar.body: The sidebar lists your projects and sessions. The bottom group opens the global tools — Memory, Always-On, Tasks, and the cost Dashboard.

research.title: Research panel: evidence-first science
research.body: The research panel is your lab bench: multi-source literature search (arXiv / OpenAlex / Crossref / OpenReview / Zotero), the claim graph, and the artifact DAG. Every research step lands as an immutable, content-addressed artifact — fully auditable.

workspace.title: Workspace: files, git and shell
workspace.body: Files, Git, and Shell tabs give the agent a full working environment. Experiment scripts, LaTeX sources, and results live here; the agent can execute remote jobs (local / SSH / Slurm) and render manuscripts.

settings.title: Settings: one config, every surface
settings.body: All configuration lives in one place. Model pool, agents, memory, web search, cron, gateway — and the research features on the next steps.

router.title: Research-aware routing
router.body: The router learns which model tier actually succeeds for each task signature: capability requirements upgrade weak classifications, an amortized ranker skips the judge once enough observations exist, and sticky guardrails release broken pinning automatically.

vision.title: Vision assistant & figure generation
vision.body: Configure an OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint (GitHub Copilot compatible) so text-only models can still read figures — images are described and injected automatically. The figure generation section adds GPT Image style figure creation for papers.

globalTools.title: Global tools: memory, automation, dashboard
globalTools.body: Memory persists what the agent learns about you and each project. Always-On and Cron keep autonomous discovery and scheduled research running. The Dashboard tracks cost and usage per model tier.

bootstrap.title: The self-bootstrapping milestone
bootstrap.body: Open a project folder and ask for a research direction: the platform walks the belief-driven loop — claim graph → expected-information-gain plan → literature → experiments → manuscript → review. The repository ships a bootstrap framework paper project (bootstrap/framework-paper/) that demonstrates the whole loop. Good luck with your research!
